articles.description: Abarna, a 17-year-old girl from Solaipudur, was murdered by Muthuraj after rejecting his demands. The incident occurred at her home in Sawyerpuram, involving a fatal stabbing and strangulation. Muthuraj, who had known Abarna for two years, also attempted suicide after the attack. Police arrived promptly and took Muthuraj to the hospital for treatment. Investigations are ongoing as authorities handle the case.

After Ukraine strikes, Crimea bridge to take 'few months' to clear
articles.description: Ukraine's defense minister has stated that clearing the debris from the Kerch Strait Bridge will span several months following its damage from Ukrainian drone and missile strikes targeted at the automobile section. President Zelenskyy has called these strikes a critical retaliation against Russian aggressions towards Ukrainian infrastructure. In contrast, President Putin has vowed to reconstruct the bridge, a vital asset and symbol of Russia's authority over Crimea.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' day 17: Ranbir Kapoor, Yash film outperforms 'KGF: Chapter 2'
articles.description: Ramayana: Rise of a Legend continues to perform well at the box office on its 17th day. The film earned Rs 27.40 crore net in India, marking a notable increase from the previous day. Its total domestic net collection has reached Rs 906.90 crore, while the worldwide gross stands at Rs 1,616.70 crore. The Hindi version remains the largest contributor to earnings, accounting for 76% of total collections.

articles.title: Anushka Pimputkar calls out edited viral bus video
articles.description: Anushka Pimputkar criticized the viral edited video that misrepresented a promotional clip for her film Janak. She explained that the original video included important context which was removed before sharing online. Deepika Bhardwaj and social media users reacted to the footage, further complicating the situation. Anushka urged individuals to delete the edited video and highlighted the negative impact of misinformation.

articles.title: Jeff Satur turns to Aamir Khan's '3 Idiots' dialogue to manage anxiety
articles.description: Jeff Satur has found comfort in the phrase 'All is well' from the movie '3 Idiots'. He applies this phrase as a coping mechanism for his anxiety during difficult situations. Jeff shared this personal practice during an interview on The Standard KND podcast. Additionally, he has been making strides in his music and acting career. The original film is reportedly set to receive a sequel, currently in the writing stage.
